decisions.quote: The replication of the sensory processing differences was not successful which can possibly be attributed to the nature of the sample.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly state in the Abstract, Discussion opening, and Conclusions that the replication was not successful, treating the small number of high-AQ participants as a possible explanation for the failed replication rather than withholding a substantive verdict.

decisions.quote: Regarding the second aim, it was expected that the German student sample would show similar sensory processing differences as the French sample depending on whether participants scored higher or lower on the AQ [ 51 ]. More precisely, a stronger correlation between hyper- and hyposensitivity, higher hypersensitivity scores in relation to hyposensitivity scores, and a more homogeneous pattern of sensory processing differences in all seven sensory modalities for individuals with higher compared to individuals with lower AQ scores were expected.
decisions.reason: This study explicitly re-tests the sensory profile findings reported by Sapey-Triomphe et al. (2018) [51] in addition to Robertson and Simmons (2013) [48], making Sapey-Triomphe et al. (2018) an omitted replication target.
